question: Should this protected, repository-wide session-storage refactor be approved once its current-head upgrade and real-session proof is reviewed, or should it be narrowed into smaller independently mergeable changes?
rationale: The intended storage direction is supported by repository policy, but the PR changes 428 files and several compatibility boundaries; choosing acceptable migration and rollout evidence requires maintainer judgment.

options.title: Review and land as one refactor
options.body: Accept the consolidated SQLite-only migration after redacted live-session, doctor-import, and export proof confirms the current head preserves supported upgrade behavior.

options.title: Split compatibility boundaries
options.body: Keep the storage teardown direction but separate Plugin SDK, export, memory, and channel-facing compatibility changes into smaller reviewable PRs.

recommendation.title: Review and land as one refactor
recommendation.body: Accept the consolidated SQLite-only migration after redacted live-session, doctor-import, and export proof confirms the current head preserves supported upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current branch and authored the supplied sequence of session-identity and compatibility corrections.
